about: Gregory C. Abel is a top-rated attorney selected to Super Lawyers for 2005 - 2026. He works at Whiting, Ross, Abel & Campbell, LLP, located in Walnut Creek, California, and provides legal services for issues involving Family Law to the surrounding community.
Gregory Abel completed legal studies at University of Oregon School of Law and graduated with the class of 1991. Gregory Abel passed the bar in 1992.

Only a few attorneys from each state are selected to Super Lawyers designation for any given year. The multi-factor selection process includes independent research, peer nominations and evaluations, as well as professional achievement in legal practice.
